title: ClassSessionChanged
description: Hold ændret: a class session got a new start time. Published by Booking, consumed by Notification (docs/domain/CONTEXT-MAP.md section 5). The message carries the correlation ID in its X-Correlation-ID header, not in the body.

classSessionId.description: The id of the class session. Consumers use it with startTime to handle the same event only once.

memberIds.description: The members who had a reservation at the change, not the waitlisted (MemberId, from Membership). May be empty.

previousStartTime.description: When the class session was going to start, ISO 8601 with an offset.

startTime.description: When the class session starts now, ISO 8601 with an offset.
